content:
When disconnecting the wires and pulling them out, be VERY careful of the Chamber Thermistor.  (plug is second from left at top of buddy board - labeled TEMP; has 2 wires). 
It is delicate, and easy to break.
It may be better to remove that first to keep it out of harms way.  Mine got jostled too much and had to be replaced in order to boot up the printer after the upgrade.
I found using the rivet removal tool to push the connect up while pushing in the safety latch with my other hand helped.
The "filament" connector is the 3rd connector from the left and is marked "filament" on the board under the connector.
RGB LED Cable is behind a large mess of wires on the right side for me. It's not as clean as the 3rd photo.
